mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (treatment_id, user_id, title, content, image_url, hash_tag, hits, is_hidden, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{treatmentId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{imageUrl}, #{hashTag}, 0, false, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT review_id, treatment_id, user_id, title, content, image_url, hash_tag, hits, is_hidden, created_at, updated_at FROM review WHERE is_hidden = false ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT review_id, treatment_id, user_id, title, content, image_url, hash_tag, hits, is_hidden, created_at, updated_at FROM review ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT review_id, treatment_id, user_id, title, content, image_url, hash_tag, hits, is_hidden, created_at, updated_at FROM review WHERE treatment_id = #{treatmentId} AND is_hidden = false ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, hash_tag = #{hashTag}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
UPDATE review SET is_hidden = #{isHidden}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
